description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Enterprise Manager for Siebel product of Oracle Enterprise Manager (component: Configuration Management).  Supported versions that are affected are 13.5 and  24.1. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Enterprise Manager for Siebel.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Enterprise Manager for Siebel. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).
